provenance: SaveProfile 0x1802158c0 -> SaveToDeviceAsync 0x180215180 -> worker lambda_b38b6a 0x180215330: PathReplaceExtension(profile,'.sjson') 0x1802154b9, writer lambda_b2fde993 Invoker 0x1802176b0 -> jmp SGD_Serialize<ConfigOptions> 0x18010aa50

ProfileManager::Load 0x1802161a0: ChangeRelativePathExtension(.sjson) 0x1802162f8, ConfigOptions::Defaults 0x18021636e, reader lambda_099d4baa Invoker 0x180217540 -> jmp SGD_Deserialize<ConfigOptions>(FileStream) 0x18010d2d0, then SetConfigOptions(ConfigFileName) 0x18021653d and ParseCommandLineOptions
profile_settings.location: Local (and optional remote) platform save device; the 'Profiles' string is passed as the container name (0x1802163a6, 0x18021561a). The PC directory mapping lives in the save-device implementation and was not reconstructed. Android: app-private storage with the same file names.
profile_settings.written_when: ProfileManager::SaveProfile callers include KeyMappingScreen::OnExit 0x1801b4dd7, MiscSettingsScreen, CloudSettingsScreen, App::Resize, AnnouncementScreen::ExitScreen.

files.other_config_sources: ConfigOptions::SetConfigOptions 0x180105f60: LoadConfig(ConfigFileName with .sjson, resource 0x1a) else 'ConfigOptions/<name>.sjson' (resource 0x18), then always 'Game/UpdateInfo.sjson'; LoadConfig 0x180105e60 follows ConfigInclude recursively. ConfigFileName defaults to empty (initializer 0x180013040) and is not a registered field. These are content/preset files, not user settings.

value_text.string: "%s" without escaping; an empty string produces no text after '= '
value_text.other(enum DebugOverlay::Category flags): quoted ', '-joined category names (GetStringForCategory); kept raw by the port

sjson_syntax.reader: SGD_Deserialize<ConfigOptions> 0x18010d2d0: strips UTF-8/UTF-16/UTF-32 BOMs, nfjp_parse_with_settings 0x180325ed0 (nflibs nf_json_parser) with settings int[9] = {1,1,0,1,1,1,1,1,1}; root must be '{' (settings[2]=0 -> parse_value, 0x180325f79); '//' and '/* */' comments (settings[1]) and commas (settings[3]) are whitespace (skip_whitespace 0x180327700); keys may be unquoted (parse_key); '=' or ':' separators (0x180326fa2/0x180326fad); JSON escapes incl. \uXXXX and Python """ strings (parse_string 0x180326350, settings[5]).
sjson_syntax.key_matching: Field map uses sgg::HashAsciiIgnoreCase/PredicateAsciiIgnoreCase: keys are case-insensitive.
sjson_syntax.unknown_keys: Ignored on load (DoFindNode miss -> next member, 0x18010af11) and never written. The port preserves them verbatim (round trip) as an explicit addition.
sjson_syntax.load_order: ConfigOptions::Defaults 0x180105830 (RestoreDefault on every field) runs before the file is applied, so absent keys mean default.

type_conversion_on_load.bool: false/true literals only; other values leave the current value (0x18010af36)
type_conversion_on_load.long: SGD_Deserialize<long> 0x18010d4e0: number trunc, false 0, true 1, object -> its first value, else unchanged
type_conversion_on_load.string: SGD_Deserialize 0x18003f130: null -> '', number -> '%f', string -> text, object -> first value, else unchanged; then sgg::Unescape replaces every '\\\\' with '\\' (0x18010b25c)

sjson_syntax.is_default: sgg::IsDefaultValue 0x180103e00: exact for bool/int/long/string; float equal if |a-b| <= 2^-146 (0x00000008) or |a-b| <= 1e-4 * max(|a|,|b|) (0x38d1b717).

field_registry.source: 352 `dynamic initializer for 'sgg::ConfigOptions::*'` procedures; 346 register an sgg::Field {i32 type, i32 flags, void* value, eastl::any default @+0x10} via string_hash_map<Field>::insert 0x18010d860 or registerField<string> 0x18010d1a0.

flags.1: not saved to the profile (SGD_Serialize skip); still accepted on load
flags.2: machine-wide: ConfigOptions::GetOptionsByType 0x180105a70 collects them so App::Reset/RemoteProfileScreen keep them across a profile reload
flags.4: set only on window/display options (DisplayIndex, FullScreen, NoBorder, WindowX/Y, X, Y, ScreenshotCount); consumer not recovered

field_registry.lua_only_note: These are reachable through ScriptAction::SetConfigOption/GetPropertyInfo 0x1801065d0 but not through the .sjson reader/writer.

android_options.name: Brightness
android_options.note: Android uses a different UI scale; map to the original 0..1 value

android_notes.explanation: DrawBloom, DrawLights, ShowUIAnimations, ShowSpeechBubble, UseOcclusion, ShowOffscreenIndicators, UseLowResAssets and others are flag-1 fields: the PC game never writes them to Profile1.sjson. ConfigFile::WriteOptions::includeNotSavedOptions=true writes non-default values anyway (Android adaptation); the original reader accepts them because SGD_Deserialize does not test flags.
android_notes.profile_save_file: EasyMode is also copied into the .sav header (save-contract.json payload_v16 u8 SaveInfo+0x70).

controls_format.container: BinarySaveData without checksum: 'SGB1' magic (0x31424753) only, 4-byte header (ctor 0x180189c10, PrepareForWrite 0x1802043a0). Reader BinaryLoadData::fromStream 0x180204130: magic sets cppCompat; without magic the legacy 7-bit-length string path is used (not supported by the port).
layout: count x record in Scheme hash-map iteration order (the loader is order-independent)
record: i32 OrKeys count, then each key as i32 GetMappedKeyFromGaInputKey(KeyboardButtonId) (0x18019a9ec)
controls_format.the 'OrKeys'/'GamepadButton'/'MouseButto: built and discarded around each write; binary mode stores no field names
controls_format.gamepad_read: RemappableControl::Load 0x18019b05f: inverse of the table; any other value leaves PadButtonMax_ (76).
controls_format.keys: Windows virtual-key codes via GetMappedKeyFromGaInputKey 0x18019bf90; read back with GetCorrectlyMappedKey 0x18019bac0. Non-identity pairs in key-mapping-tables.json / config_file.cpp. Not a perfect inverse: KeyPlus 158 -> 187 reads back as 187.
controls_format.record_version_mismatch: Load 0x18019ae73: version != 1 returns a disabled control after reading only the version.
controls_format.apply: Worker 0x180190307..0x180190472: for each enabled record, FNV-1a bucket lookup + memcmp on ControlName in Controls::Scheme; copies OrKeys, GamepadButton, MouseButton, UseGamepadButton, RequiresShift. Unknown names ignored.
controls_format.gate: Applied only if the file loaded (status 3), ConfigOptions::LoadSavedControls (flag 1, default true) and ControlsResetRevision (flag 1, default 16755) <= ControlsResetRevisionViewed (persisted, default 0) (0x18019028f..0x1801902a8).
controls_format.when_saved: KeyMappingScreen ctor sets ControlsResetRevisionViewed = atoi("36401") (0x1801b1656); KeyMappingScreen::OnExit 0x1801b4dc0: SaveProfile, ConfigOptions::Apply, DefaultControlsChosen = true, SaveControls(profile).
controls_format.control_names: ControlName differs from the input_bindings control id for Up/Down/Left/Right (MoveUp/MoveDown/MoveLeft/MoveRight) and Pause (Start); see default-bindings-contract.json controlName.
controls_format.defaults: input_bindings defaultBindings(); UseGamepadButton=1 where SetupScheme(name,pad) ran; ReportFeedback/TakeScreenshot keep R3/Select with UseGamepadButton=0; RequiresShift false (no non-copy store found in Controls/RemappableControl code).

uncertainties: Profile directory on PC (save-device container 'Profiles') was not reconstructed; only file names are proven.
nfjp settings[0], [4..8] semantics are inferred from nflibs field order plus observed checks; settings[1],[2],[3],[5] and '='/':' handling are observed.
SGD_Serialize writes in Field hash-map iteration order; the port writes registry (alphabetical) order. The reader is order-independent.
.ctrls records are written in Controls::Scheme hash order in the original; the port writes the caller's order. The loader is order-independent.
Type 5 (DebugOverlay::Category) FromString/ToString are not reconstructed; the port keeps the raw text.
An nfjp parse error makes the port apply nothing (values stay at defaults); the engine's behaviour after its longjmp error path was not traced further.
